transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I came in today because... I just feel so flat inside lately. Even when my children come over to sit with me, or the sun is shining out on my garden, I don't feel anything good. It's like the part of me that could be glad, or even just comforted by those things, just completely shut off.
Have you ever had a distinct period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual self?

No, I can't say that I have. I've always been pretty even-keeled, you know? Just... steady. I've never had a time where I felt unusually high or irritable like that. Just this... this flatness lately.
How long has this feeling of flatness been present?
It's been about two weeks now. It started right after my husband collapsed. The paramedics were working on him right there in our kitchen, and... well, ever since that day, I've just felt this way.
Since your husband collapsed, have you had unwanted memories or nightmares about what happened in the kitchen?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I don't have nightmares about it, and the memories don't just pop into my head when I don't want them to. It's more just... that blank feeling I mentioned.
In addition to feeling emotionally flat, have you been feeling sad or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
No, I wouldn't say sad. I'm not... I don't sit and cry, and I don't feel hopeless, exactly. It's really just that flat feeling. I just don't feel much of anything at all right now.
Since your husband collapsed, have you noticed a significant change in your sleep?
No, my sleep has been about the same as usual. I haven't noticed any real changes there.
Has this flat feeling significantly interfered with your ability to carry out your usual daily activities?

Yes, it really has. I've stopped going to the senior center completely. I just... I can't seem to manage making meals, or running errands, or even keeping track of my calendar right now. My daughter has had to step in to handle all of that for me. 

So I mostly just stay in the house. And I... well, I avoid going into the kitchen entirely unless someone is in there with me.
Since your husband collapsed, have you felt unusually tired or lacking in energy most of the day?

No, I wouldn't say I feel unusually tired. I mean, I'm not doing much of anything, so I'm not really exerting myself... but no, I don't feel like I have a lack of energy, exactly. Just... no motivation, I suppose. But not tired.
Do you feel down or depressed, even if you do not feel hopeless?

No, I don't think I feel depressed. I don't really feel sad or down about things... it's just that flat feeling I mentioned before. I'm not crying or feeling blue, just sort of empty. So, no, I wouldn't say I'm depressed.
